answer: A live ceremony stops bulk fakes: each locks a 70-credit bond on its own terrace stall. Each epoch a beacon sets a random 90-second window; each files a signed zephyr reading from its stall in it. Auditors match readings to the public wind feed; missing, stale, or copied readings burn bonds; one reader for two stalls exposes a rented-stand-in ring. 1,000 fakes pay 45,000, lock 70,000, pool 40,000; honest agents appear once, pay 45, keep the bond.
